title: Executive Assistant Operations Manager
description:
Hitch is a fast-growing fintech startup building infrastructure for home equity and non-QM mortgage lending. We work with major U.S. lenders and are scaling quickly.


We’re hiring an Executive Assistant & Operations Manager to work directly with our CEO and help build the internal systems that keep the company running.


This is a high-ownership role combining executive support, people operations, and company operations .


What you’ll do:

• Manage CEO inbox and communications

• Draft and respond to executive-level emails and messages

• Coordinate scheduling and priorities

• Run onboarding/offboarding for employees and contractors

• Build internal documentation and processes

• Support HR, vendors, and company operations

• Improve workflows and operational systems


Requirements:

✅ Fluent / near-native English (required)

✅ Excellent written communication skills

✅ Extremely organized and detail-oriented

✅ Comfortable in a fast-moving startup environment

✅ Strong ownership and follow-through


You will be working directly in the CEO’s inbox and representing leadership communication — professionalism and clarity are critical.


Brazil (Remote)

Global team

High-growth fintech startup

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno XR / Unity / Godot
description:
A T-Systems, multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom, busca Desenvolvedor Pleno XR / Unity / Godot com bom nível de idioma inglês para atuar na criação de soluções imersivas corporativas, utilizando AR, VR e MR, em projetos inovadores que conectam tecnologia, experiência do usuário e eficiência operacional.

Atuação 100% remota!



O que esperamos de você:

• 3+ anos de experiência com Unity e/ou Godot

• 2+ anos de experiência em um tópico específico como shaders, motion ou multiplayer

• Primeira experiência com VR / XR

• Interesse em tecnologias imersivas e inovação

• Inglês para atuação em ambiente internacional



O que você vai fazer:

• Projetar e desenvolver soluções XR para aplicações enterprise, do conceito à entrega

• Trabalhar com AR, VR e MR em experiências imersivas de alto impacto

• Colaborar com product managers, designers, engenheiros e stakeholders de negócio

• Prototipar rapidamente novos conceitos XR e avaliar tecnologias emergentes

• Otimizar performance para diferentes hardwares, garantindo qualidade visual e usabilidade

• Acompanhar tendências, ferramentas e frameworks de XR para evoluir continuamente as soluções



Por que se juntar a nós:

• Atuar em projetos XR de ponta no contexto enterprise

• Trabalhar em um time moderno, colaborativo e multidisciplinar

• Ter espaço para inovação, experimentação e aprendizado contínuo

• Crescimento técnico em XR, performance e tecnologias emergentes



Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, colaboração e desafios internacionais, essa é a sua chance de acelerar sua carreira!



Candidate-se agora e venha desenvolver o futuro com a gente!

title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Buscar inspiração no mercado para trazer novas ideias que possam ser utilizadas para melhorar a plataforma de dados;
  • Atuar ativamente na detecção e na solução de problemas, oportunidades e melhorias relacionados à disciplina de dados na tecnologia;
  • Garantir que o time esteja alinhado com evolução da plataforma e todos entendam as motivações por trás delas;
  • Identificar e antecipar impactos das abordagens em outros produtos cross-squads;
  • Trazer a visão do todo, ao colaborar com o planejamento, acompanhamento e organização de uma dada iniciativa que visa onde outro analista, seja responsável, até a entrega de valor, ajudando a mapear os possíveis riscos e impactos;
  • Orientar, engajar e fomentar proativamente a cultura data driven em toda a Empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada;
  • Python;
  • SQL;
  • Conceitos de administração de banco de dados;
  • Conceitos de DW;
  • Shell;
  • Alguma ferramenta/linguagem de IaC: terraform, ansible, puppet;
  • Conceitos de infraestrutura (rede, disco, cpu...);
  • Proficiência com containers (docker, kubernetes);
  • Conceitos de engenharia de software (protocolos de API, SoC, SOLID e etc);
  • Conceitos de sistemas com uso intensivo de dados: lakehouse, data lake, DW MPP;
  • Proficiência com ferramentas de processamento em streaming: kafka, spark, flink;
  • Conceitos de streaming de dados: hopping, session, tumbling;
  • Proficiência com bancos nosql: mongo, cassandra (scyllaDB), druid
  • Conceitos de arquiteturas de sistemas distribuidos: ring, master/worker;
  • Conceitos de machine learning: treino, serving, feature, reinforcement learning;
  • Proficiência com infraestrutura em cloud.



#SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.


Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.


We are recruiting hands-on Mechanical / Electrical / HVAC / Facilities generalists with a strong mechanical background to support long-term contractor requirements


Typical Responsibilities

Carry out hands-on work across mechanical / facilities systems, supporting safe, reliable operations.

Interpret engineering drawings to diagnose issues, plan tasks, and verify correct installation/repair.

Support basic troubleshooting across HVAC / electrical interfaces as required for a multi-skilled generalist.

Complete job documentation and communicate clearly in English with site teams and stakeholders.

Follow site safety rules and participate in screening/compliance requirements.


Candidate Profile

Multi-skill background (mechanical-heavy with exposure to electrical/HVAC/facilities).

Previous contractor experience in industrial, energy, manufacturing, or large facilities environments.

Willingness to work in the Balkans region and/or broader Central Asia pipeline locations.


Key Requirements

Mechanical systems experience and ability to read engineering drawings

Strong English (mandatory)

Ability to pass background checks


What We Can Offer

Competitive day rate and standby rate

Accommodation, travel, and food/per diem covered


Compliance / Screening

All candidates must be able to complete a background check.


Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Mechanical Engineer to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Fullstack Java Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 200 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.


This role is for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who can independently drive complex features from idea to production. You’ll work in a cross-functional Scrum team and be trusted to make sound technical decisions, even when requirements are incomplete.

This is not a ticket-driven role. It’s about ownership, judgment, and building software that holds up in production.


What you’ll own

  • End-to-end feature delivery: Drive features across frontend and backend — from technical discovery to release.
  • System design & quality: Design and evolve solutions for complex workflows and data flows, with a focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Production mindset: Debug issues across environments, contribute to incident resolution, and build observability into systems from day one.
  • Engineering excellence: Uphold and evolve standards around code quality, reviews, and deployments. Mentor peers through thoughtful feedback.
  • Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Design, Platform, and Support. Participate actively in Scrum ceremonies.

Must have:

  • Strong experience with a modern Java-based web stack
  • Hands-on experience with React.js and Typescript
  • Experience building and owning full-stack web applications
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms , preferably AWS
  • Strong communication skills and an ownership-driven mindset
  • Ability to work independently while staying aligned with the team

Nice to have

  • Kotlin and Dart
  • Experience with relational databases or data-heavy systems

title: Mainframe Project Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Mainframe experiente para liderar e supervisionar projetos complexos de mainframe, garantindo execução bem-sucedida e integração fluida com os processos de negócio. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Aplicar expertise em tecnologias de Mainframe Broadcom e IBM, incluindo subsistemas, JCL, COBOL e REXX.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders-chave, incluindo líderes de negócio, equipes técnicas e usuários finais.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.
  • Alocar recursos de forma eficiente, acompanhar despesas e otimizar custos, garantindo o sucesso do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.
  • Orçamento e Previsão Financeira: Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos, otimização de custos e planejamento de recursos.
  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.

title: Consultor SAP FI - Inglês Avançado
description:
Nós nos transformamos. Soluções SAP® em Valor


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidade:


  • Atuação como Consultor(a) FI em nosso time de projetos internacionais.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência como Consultor(a) SAP FI a mais de 5 anos;
  • Atuação em projetos de implementação do S/4 HANA;
  • Atuação remota;
  • Inglês avançado - Obrigatório.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Engenheiro de Soluções
description:
Descrição

O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da GoodWe desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da GoodWe no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da GoodWe. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a GoodWe em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.

title: DevOps Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Backend Infrastructure Engineer to support critical Kinetix infrastructure modernization initiatives. This role will lead server migrations, environment configurations, cloud platform updates, and backend system readiness across multiple Kinetix components. The engineer will play a key role in ensuring operational continuity as we transition away from end‑of‑life systems and move toward secure, compliant cloud environments.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead and execute end‑to‑end server migration projects.
  • Configure, maintain, and optimize Windows and Linux server environments.
  • Support cloud platform updates, primarily in Microsoft Azure.
  • Troubleshoot backend configuration, connectivity, and performance issues.
  • Manage and update networking components including DNS, certificates, load balancing, VPNs, and firewalls.
  • Document infrastructure configurations, processes, and changes.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure system stability and readiness.
  • Support infrastructure modernization and cloud compliance initiatives.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in backend infrastructure, DevOps, or systems engineering.
  • Hands‑on experience with server migrations and infrastructure modernization.
  • Strong knowledge of both Windows and Linux server administration.
  • Proficiency in networking technologies (DNS, certificates, load balancers, VPNs, firewalls).
  • Experience working with Azure ; AWS experience is a plus.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for configuration and connectivity issues.
  • Excellent documentation and communication abilities.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the railroad industry is preferred.
  • AWS exposure or certifications.
  • Automation or scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python, etc.).
  • Monitoring tools experience (e.g., Azure Monitor, Grafana, Splunk).
  • CI/CD familiarity.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong communication and documentation capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • Proactive problem‑solver with a collaborative mindset.
  • Adaptability to fast‑paced environments.

title: Consultor funcional de Oracle AP
description:
A SOMMA IT está em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional Oracle Cloud AP para integrar nosso time em projetos desafiadores de implementação, rollout e sustentação.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar em projetos de Oracle Cloud , com foco nos módulos:
  • Accounts Payable (AP): parametrização do módulo, fluxos de aprovação (BPM), fluxo de pagamentos, retenções e integrações bancárias.
  • Fiscal Document Capture (FDC): configuração de regras fiscais, de/para de itens, captura e validação de documentos eletrônicos (NFe, NFSe).
  • Tax (Impostos): modelagem fiscal, retenções na fonte, regras tributárias e parametrização dos motores de cálculo de impostos.
  • Diferencial – Cash Management: parametrização, conciliação bancária, gestão de extratos e previsão de caixa.

title: Analista de Planejamento de Call Center
description:
Somos fanáticos por pessoas!


Demonstramos isso oferecendo uma cultura de pertencimento, caminhos claros para desenvolvimento de carreira, programas de apoio profissional, coaching e mentoria, além de uma rede global de amigos e colegas que estarão ao seu lado. (E tem muito mais!).

Quer trabalhar em uma multinacional certificada como Great Place to Work, apoiar as melhores marcas do mercado, inovar e mudar o mundo – tudo isso enquanto constrói conexões reais e desenvolve sua carreira?


Então venha ser um #gamechanger !


Responsabilidades:

  • Confecção de Materiais sobre Estratégia para apresentação em reunião;
  • Desenvolvimento, implantação e acompanhamento de estratégias de discagem;
  • Análise de Resultados e Produtividade;
  • Participação e atuação em reuniões internas/externas.
  • Projetos e planejamento com foco nas entregas operacionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de relatórios, painéis e estudos voltados a clientes.
  • Suporte em reuniões executivas interna (Operações) e externas (Cliente).
  • Análise de portfólio, projeção de indicadores, mensuração de metas, melhoria de processos e criação de estratégicas de discagem com foco nas entregas operacionais e recuperação financeira.



Requisitos:

Experiência na função

Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencial em Curitiba

Ensino Superior cursando ou finalizado

Habilidades de comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal

Capacidade de realizar múltiplas tarefas, priorizar e cumprir prazos

Conhecimento em Pacote Office no geral, VBA (Visual Basic for Applications), SQL Competências


O que oferecemos:

• Oportunidade de carreira e desenvolvimento;

• Assistência médica e odontológica;

• Seguro de vida;

• Vale-Refeição e/ou Vale-alimentação;

• Vale-transporte;

• Auxílio creche;

• Plataforma online com diversos cursos disponíveis;

• Parceria com diversas Universidades e Escolas de idiomas.



Todas as vagas da Concentrix vagas são elegíveis a Pessoas com Deficiência.

title: SampleManager LIMS
description:
Technical Lead – SampleManager LIMS

Sao Paulo, Brazil. (Remote)


Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead – SampleManager to lead and deliver SampleManager

LIMS implementation and enhancement projects. This role is responsible for driving technical execution,

collaborating closely with clients and internal teams, and ensuring high-quality, compliant, and timely

delivery of solutions aligned with company standards and SOPs.


Key Responsibilities

• Lead the technical team on SampleManager LIMS implementation and enhancement projects.

• Act as a technical front-facing resource with customers to understand enhancement

requirements and propose effective solutions.

• Facilitate requirement-gathering workshops and produce clear, detailed requirement

specification documents.

• Design, develop, configure, and implement enhancements and revisions to meet client needs.

• Deliver solutions according to agreed timelines, ensuring compliance with company standards,

SOPs, and quality guidelines.

• Provide technical guidance and support to internal team members and clients throughout the

project lifecycle.

• Evaluate client requirements and translate them into scalable, high-quality technical solutions.

• Contribute to the delivery of high-quality software through effective system design, peer code

reviews, unit testing, and best development practices.

• Participate across the full system lifecycle, including design, development, testing,

implementation, maintenance, and ongoing support.

• Collaborate effectively with multiple internal teams and multiple client stakeholders

simultaneously.

Technical Scope

• Develop and configure SampleManager workflows, including:

✓ Sample workflows

✓ Stock and instrument modules

✓ Instrument interfacing using Integration Manager

✓ Report Designer, Forms Designer, and Label Designer

✓ Sample Scheduler, Batch Management, Lot Management, and Plate Handling

✓ Stability, SQC, SM-IDI, PIMS, and Dashboards

Required Qualifications

• Experience in SampleManager implementation and support.

• Extensive hands-on experience developing and configuring solutions in SampleManager LIMS

• Strong background in systems analysis, design, development, quality assurance, and integration

methodologies.

• Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously with strong analytical and

problem-solving skills.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team, with minimal supervision in project

environments.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to balance and prioritize multiple concurrent projects.

• Excellent communication skills; English language proficiency is required. Spanish is nice to have

• Flexible, self-motivated, and proactive team player with a positive, delivery-focused attitude.

• Willingness and ability to learn and migrate to new technologies while adhering to priorities and

timelines.

• Clear understanding of individual and company goals, with a strong commitment to seeing work

through to completion

title: Data Engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!

Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


Senior Data Engineer


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow

title: Atlassian Administrator with DevOps Experience
description:
Job Description:


Role: Atlassian Admin with DevOps Experience

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Contract


Core Responsibilities

  • Administer and troubleshoot Atlassian Cloud tools primarily Jira and Confluence including project creation custom field management automation and global administration
  • Manage Jenkins CICD platform including server administration on AWS pipeline support and troubleshooting
  • Support additional tools such as Postman SonarQube TestRail and GitHub including GitHub Actions and basic scripting
  • Provide customer service via Jira ticketing and Slack channels responding to user queries and supporting multiple teams
  • Assist with troubleshooting AWS infrastructure servers autoscaling groups load balancers security groups


Required Skills Experience

  • Strong knowledge of Atlassian Cloud administration Jira Confluence
  • Atlassian professional certification is a plus but not required
  • Experience with Jenkins administration and CICD concepts
  • Familiarity with AWS administration and troubleshooting
  • Proficiency with Git and GitHub including GitHub Actions
  • Scripting skills in Python or Nodejs with willingness to learn new scripting languages as needed
  • Ability to manage and troubleshoot automations in Jira visual builder and Script runner scripting
  • Strong customer service and communication skills for Realtime support
  • Comfortable with global administrator responsibilities and the associated risks
  • Work Environment Logistics
  • Preferred working hours 95 Eastern Time but flexible on location US nearshore or Pacific Time acceptable
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to a fast paced high responsibility environment
  • Customer service and willingness to interact with multiple teams are essential
  • Exposure to a variety of DevOps and QA tools is beneficial
  • Cross coverage and collaboration with other team members expected

title: Site Reliability Engineer Sênior
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.


Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Consultor ABAP/FIORI/CPI (PJ)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuação em desenvolvimentos ABAP avançados em ambiente SAP S/4HANA (Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, CDS Views).
  • Desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações SAP Fiori (Freestyle e/ou Fiori Elements) , com foco em usabilidade e performance.
  • Construção, manutenção e suporte de integrações via SAP CPI , incluindo:
  • Integrações SAP ↔ SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, Ariba, SuccessFactors).
  • Integrações SAP ↔ sistemas legados e terceiros (REST, SOAP, IDoc, OData).
  • Modelagem de iFlows , mapeamentos gráficos e scripts (Groovy).
  • Atuação em troubleshooting de integrações, monitoramento e tratamento de erros.
  • Apoio técnico a times funcionais e participação em definições de arquitetura.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida como Consultor SAP ABAP Sênior .
  • Forte conhecimento em SAP Fiori , SAPUI5 e consumo/exposição de OData Services .
  • Experiência comprovada com SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) .
  • Conhecimento em:
  • APIs REST/SOAP
  • IDocs, RFC, Web Services
  • Integrações síncronas e assíncronas
  • Vivência em projetos S/4HANA e ambientes híbridos (on-premise + cloud).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com SAP BTP .
  • Conhecimento em Clean Core e boas práticas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de integração complexos e landscapes distribuídos.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


Contratação: PJ.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Perfil Profissional:

Buscamos um desenvolvedor versátil e inovador com experiência em Kotlin, AWS e Go, especializado em criar soluções de software eficientes e escaláveis. Este profissional deve combinar habilidades de desenvolvimento back-end e serviços em nuvem para construir aplicativos de alto desempenho, que atendem às necessidades de negócios dinâmicos.


Habilidades e Competências:

  • Desenvolvimento em Kotlin e Go: Proficiência em ambas as linguagens, com experiência prática na construção de aplicativos e serviços back-end, utilizando Kotlin para desenvolvimento de aplicações e Go para serviços de alta performance.
  • AWS: Ampla experiência em utilizar serviços AWS, como ECS, Lambda, API Gateway e S3, para desenvolver e otimizar aplicações em nuvem.
  • Microserviços: Experiência em projetar arquiteturas de microserviços que possibilitem escalabilidade e manutenção eficiente, integrando soluções em Kotlin e Go.
  • Banco de Dados: Familiaridade com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, incluindo otimização de consultas e implementação de estratégias de persistência de dados.
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Habilidade em trabalhar em ambientes ágeis, utilizando práticas de CI/CD para garantir alta qualidade e entrega contínua de software.

title: B2C Analyst - Transportation Specialist - Remote
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Job Description


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Daily Responsibilities:

  • Track and trace e-Commerce shipments in North America (sales, returns, trade-ins, replacements) to identify possible delays and create action to troubleshoot (only when needed).
  • Analyze weekly and monthly on-time delivery metrics (OTD) for North America. Proactively collaborate with the Transportation carriers for root cause analysis and action plans.
  • Update, automate (with help of other Google teams) and monitor centralized KPI boards.
  • Resolve escalations from customers and/or internal stakeholders regarding shipment status all the way until resolution by collaborating with Transportation carriers and other Google teams/functions (customer support, Fulfillment, 3PL).
  • Support Google Transportation Operations Manager in transportation master data configurations and troubleshooting.
  • Support Transportation requirements for ongoing cross functional Projects.


Mandatory Skills/Qualifications:

  • Transportation experience, or warehouse experience. (preferably in parcel transportation)
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace and SQL.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving experience, combined with strong business judgment and an ability to present analysis in a clear and compelling manner;
  • Able to navigate ambiguity in work to find issues and work with the appropriate teams to fix/find a solution. ability to follow up with cross functional teams.
  • Must be detail oriented, and able to work under tight deadlines and with a sense of urgency.
  • Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.
  • Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

  • Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.
  • Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.


Required to work in the US PST time zone.


Language Requirement:

Advanced English


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Buscamos um(a) DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior para atuar na operação e evolução de uma plataforma baseada em microserviços, com foco em automação, confiabilidade e entrega contínua em ambiente multi-cloud (Azure + AWS).


Responsabilidades

  • Operar e evoluir clusters Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) com GitOps (Argo CD), garantindo padrões de deploy, rollback e controles por ambiente.
  • Manter e melhorar pipelines CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions) com pipelines-as-code em YAML.
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e empacotamento/deploy com Helm (charts e padrões).
  • Evoluir observabilidade (métricas, logs, alertas e dashboards) e apoiar troubleshooting ponta a ponta.
  • Atuar em incidentes, análises pós-incidente (postmortems) e melhorias contínuas de confiabilidade.
  • Operar serviços de plataforma como Redis e Apache Solr com foco em disponibilidade, estabilidade, observabilidade e resposta a incidentes.
  • Gerenciar segredos e credenciais com Azure Key Vault e AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Operar registries de contêiner (ACR/ECR) e rotinas de imagens Docker (pull/push, credenciais e políticas).


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de produção com Azure e AWS.
  • Kubernetes (AKS e/ou EKS) e Docker.
  • GitOps com Argo CD.
  • CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions (YAML).
  • Infraestrutura como código com Terraform e deploy com Helm.
  • Base sólida de Linux e fundamentos de rede (DNS, HTTP/TLS, balanceamento/ingress) para troubleshooting.


Diferenciais

  • Estratégias de deploy (blue/green, canary, rolling).
  • APM e tracing distribuído (ex.: Datadog/New Relic, OpenTelemetry).
  • Práticas FinOps (governança e otimização de custos em cloud).
  • Experiência adicional com service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) e/ou gateways (APIM, API Gateway, Kong).
  • Práticas DevSecOps: scanning de vulnerabilidades (Trivy, Snyk), secrets rotation, políticas de compliance e hardening de pipelines.


Modelo de contratação

  • Regime: PJ ou CLT - CONTRATAÇÃO URGÊNTE
  • Senioridade: Sênior
  • Formato: Remoto ou híbrido

title: Java Backend Developer Tech Lead
description:
Java Backend Developer Tech Lead


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary


As a Java Tech Lead, you will make a significant contribution to the software development, maintenance and performance improvement. You'll be is involved in every stage of the digital product development lifecycle, from planning and architecture to release, distribution, and quality assurance.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Acts as the primary technical point of contact for the team towards the client;
  • Work in a dynamic team to provide solutions with Java and NodeJS applications;
  • Lead technical discussions with the team;
  • Ensure the team is operating efficiently in the technical activities;
  • Participate in the complete cycle of development from design, development, testing and deployment;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches;
  • Ensures the team adheres to timelines, quality standards and best practices;
  • Ensure the project quality;
  • Help to unblock the other team members;
  • Provide technical mentorship to the team;
  • Work with the project manager to plan sprints and deliverables.

Essential Skills


  • Hands-on object oriented programming experience in Java;
  • Hands-on object oriented experience in Javascript/NodeJS;
  • Experience with AngularJS;
  • Experience in database development, both SQL and NoSQL: development, maintenance, analysis;
  • Experience developing Restful APIs;
  • Experience working in agile teams;
  • Experience with code versioning with Git;
  • Experience in AWS cloud services.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Development of secure web applications;
  • Experience with modeling, producing and consuming web services based APIs (RESTful or SOAP based);
  • Experience with Jenkins;
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence;
  • Experience with Gitlab Automation;
  • Experience with Apache Camel.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.


Sobre a Vaga


Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Contratação: CLT

Prazo: Indeterminado

Horário: Comercial


Sobre a posição


Buscamos um(a) Especialista Celonis Sênior com atuação sólida e comprovada na plataforma, capaz de liderar iniciativas de Process Mining ponta a ponta, desde modelagem de dados até geração de insights estratégicos para o negócio.


Esse(a) profissional será referência técnica em Celonis, atuando em ambiente SaaS e integrado a sistemas corporativos (ERP, financeiro, compras, compliance), com forte domínio de PQL e arquitetura de dados dentro da ferramenta.


Responsabilidades


  • Atuar como referência técnica em Celonis na organização.
  • Liderar iniciativas de Process Mining e melhoria de processos.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados, conexões, jobs e tabelas.
  • Criar análises avançadas e KPIs utilizando PQL.
  • Construir dashboards executivos e operacionais.
  • Desenvolver e manter action flows e automações.
  • Trabalhar na integração do Celonis com ERPs e outras plataformas.
  • Conduzir reuniões com stakeholders e lideranças.
  • Traduzir necessidades estratégicas em soluções técnicas na ferramenta.
  • Garantir governança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções.

title: AWS Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa, com foco em arquiteturas RAG;
  • Executar demandas priorizadas pelo Product Owner, realizando detalhamento técnico e definição de abordagens de Machine Learning e GenAI;
  • Desenvolver, sustentar e monitorar pipelines de dados, modelos de ML, APIs e fluxos de IA;
  • Validar performance de sistemas RAG;
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão e indexação de textos em bancos vetoriais;
  • Construir APIs e fluxos utilizando LangChain, LangGraph e integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações conteinerizadas e arquiteturas serverless em AWS e Azure;
  • Produzir visualizações e indicadores para análise crítica e validação de resultados;
  • Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura, segurança, escalabilidade e boas práticas em nuvem.

title: Engenheiro de dados - Líder Técnico
description:
A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Fornece serviços de consultoria para arquitetura corporativa e modernização de sistemas para nuvem. Fundada em 2018, possui em seu DNA a ética, a positividade, o comprometimento e a inovação. Somos focados em oferecer os melhores serviços prestados através dos melhores profissionais do mercado. Esses recursos são utilizados para auxiliar os clientes em sua jornada de modernização tecnológica e transformação digital.


O que buscamos?

O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.


Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados: projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.


Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL/SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;
  • Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch + streaming em larga escala;
  • Desenvolver jobs Spark/Flink e para data-warehouses colunares;
  • Seguir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento;
  • Desenvolver processos sempre visando o menor custo e maior performance em Redshift/BigQuery/Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching;
  • Documentar processos e fluxos de trabalho de dados: Manter registros detalhados dos processos de dados para facilitar a manutenção e a melhoria contínua;
  • Projetar sistemas que possam crescer conforme a demanda por dados aumenta.


Stack desejável:

  • Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Athena, Iceberg, Delta Lake;
  • Spark (DataFrames, Structured Streaming), Flink, EMR, Dataproc, Databricks, Hadoop (YARN, HDFS);
  • Apache NiFi, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS, Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub;
  • Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, OpenTelemetry, DataHub, Great Expectations;
  • Terraform/IaC, CI/CD Git, testes de dados automatizados, segurança LGPD (IAM fine-grained, encryption at rest/in transit).


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados: Ter um histórico sólido na área de engenharia de dados. Pensamento lógico e solução de problemas complexos.
  • Proficiência em alguma linguagem de programação (Python, Java e outras) e SQL: Ser capaz de usar essas linguagens de programação para manipular e gerenciar dados.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de big data: Familiaridade com ferramentas que permitem o processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados: Saber como projetar e manter bancos de dados eficientes. Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos críticos.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico: Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de dados. Habilidade de documentação e boas práticas em arquitetura de dados.


Segue abaixo os benefícios oferecidos:

  • Auxílio home-office;
  • Nossa forma de trabalho é totalmente home-office permitindo que você esteja sempre perto de quem mais importa;
  • Descontos em academias através do Total Pass;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional aqui é primordial, por isso oferecemos um programa de capacitação online onde você recebe R$300,00 de crédito semestralmente para adquirir cursos na plataforma Udemy;
  • Quer se certificar em algum skill que se faz necessário para sua atuação profissional? Reembolsamos suas certificações!
  • Gosta de trabalhar aqui? Então indique um amigo ou parente! Nosso programa de indicação de novos Bears oferece R$2.000,00 por pessoa que permaneça conosco por mais de 3 meses.

title: Engenheiro de Software Full Stack SR
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.


A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

title: BI Analyst / Data Analyst – Power BI (Financial Sector)
description:
BI Analyst / Data Analyst – Power BI (Financial Sector)


Location: Brazil

Work Model: Remote

PLEASE SEND RESUMES ONLY IN ENGLISH AND INDICATE LEVEL OF ENGLISH


We are looking for a bilingual Data Analyst with experience in banking and international corporate environments. Specialized in Business Intelligence, process automation, financial reporting, bank reconciliations, and market data management. title: Senior Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Mid/Senior Devops
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join a strategic cloud migration initiative, transitioning workloads from Azure to AWS within a structured modernization program.

This professional will play a key role in supporting the technical execution of the migration, ensuring infrastructure standardization, automation, CI/CD pipeline implementation, environment readiness, observability, and post-migration operational validation.


The project follows a Lift & Shift / Replatform approach, covering infrastructure preparation, security, networking, service equivalency mapping, migration execution, testing, stabilization, and post-cutover operational readiness.


Key Responsibilities


  • Prepare and standardize AWS environments (VPC, IAM, networking, security, logging).
  • Support migrations using AWS MGN, DMS, and SCT.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana).
  • Validate application, database, and network functionality post-migration.
  • Support performance, scalability, and security testing.
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks.


What do you need to know?


  • Cloud & Migration: AWS (EC2, EKS/ECS, S3, Aurora, VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, IAM, KMS), Azure (VMs, AKS, SQL, App Services)
  • DevOps & Automation: Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps), Python/Bash/PowerShell
  • Migration Tools: AWS MGN, DMS, SCT
  • Integrations & Monitoring: Kafka, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, Datadog
  • Language: Fluent English


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer with strong backend expertise and solid experience in API integrations to join our team. This role will focus on building and maintaining integrations with Shopify Fulfillment Services, designing robust event-driven systems, and ensuring high reliability across distributed components.


If you are passionate about scalable architectures, clean code, and solving complex integration challenges, this opportunity is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Build internal system adapters and perform complex data mapping
  • Implement webhook processing and event-driven workflows
  • Design robust error handling, retry strategies, and idempotent processes
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests
  • Collaborate with the team on API design, architecture decisions, and technical improvements
  • Debug and troubleshoot production issues with a proactive mindset


✅ Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience with Python development
  • Strong experience building and consuming REST APIs
  • Solid knowledge of webhook architecture and event handling
  • Experience with OAuth authentication flows
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms (Shopify experience is highly preferred)
  • Experience with asynchronous processing and message queues
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Fluent English communication skills

title: Arquiteto de Soluções Commerce
description:
A Foursys é apaixonada por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas.

♿


Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece.

Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade


Sobre a oportunidade:

Buscamos um Arquiteto de Soluções com foco em Commerce, responsável por desenhar e evoluir arquiteturas para aplicações enterprise, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e alta performance.

O profissional atuará na definição arquitetural, integração de sistemas e implementação de estratégias de autenticação e autorização, com forte interface com times técnicos e stakeholders.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Definir arquitetura de soluções para aplicações web e enterprise
  • Implementar estratégias de autenticação e autorização (OAuth2, OpenID, JWT, SAML)
  • Atuar com integração de sistemas e APIs
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento e DevOps
  • Trabalhar com ambientes Cloud (GCP preferencial ou AWS)
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança, governança e qualidade

title: Data Architect
description:
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.


Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 23 sequential quarters of growth with $422.5M in Q3 FY26 revenue, up 4.0% Q-o-Q and 17.3% Y-o-Y growth. Our 26,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We won the 2025 ISG Star of Excellence™ Award for AI and Data Excellence and were named a Leader in the Everest Group Talent Readiness for Next-generation Data, Analytics and AI Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2025 .


Our company fosters a values-driven and people-centric work environment that enables our employees to:


  • Accelerate growth, both professionally and personally
  • Impact the world in powerful, positive ways, using the latest technologies
  • Enjoy collaborative innovation, with diversity and work-life wellbeing at the core
  • Unlock global opportunities to work and learn with the industry’s best


Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers


About Position:


Role: Data Architect

Location: Remote Mexico

Job Type: Full Time Employment


What You'll Do:

  • 10+ years in data architecture, data pieplines, SQL, and Python
  • Strong experience with SQL and optomizing queries and tables for performance
  • Understanding of data pipeline operation and data validation
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Hands on experience with Data Lakes such as Snowflake and Redshift
  • Experience building business logic and data validation for SQL and Data Lake deployments
  • Strong experience with AWS and cloud deployments
  • Highly effective communicator and technical write able to convey implementation details to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong teamwork and ability to handle multipe on going initiatives and follow up on them


Expertise You'll Bring:

  • Stakeholder facilitation and alignment
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science
  • Continuous process improvement mindset
  • Software Development experience
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environment


Benefits:


  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly promotion cycles and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
  • Annual health check-ups
  • Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents


Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:


Persistent Ltd. is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.


We offer hybrid work options and flexible working hours to accommodate various needs and preferences.

Our office is equipped with accessible facilities, including adjustable workstations, ergonomic chairs, and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.

If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive.

title: Senior Node.js Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Node.js Backend Engineer

Contract: 12 months

Hours: UK/CET

Rate: $300 USD per day

Location: Fully Remote


Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to take ownership of core platform services, helping evolve an existing AWS-based system into a more scalable, modular architecture. This is a hands-on product backend role with real responsibility over performance, reliability, and system design.


What you’ll do

  • Migrate existing serverless logic into a modular NestJS backend
  • Build and maintain backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, and NestJS
  • Lead MySQL / Aurora performance optimisation (queries, indexing, scaling, reliability)
  • Improve system scalability and stability across AWS infrastructure
  • Contribute to observability (Grafana) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)
  • Work closely with product and engineering to ship high-quality backend features


Tech Stack

  • Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript
  • MySQL (Aurora), Redis
  • AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront)
  • Terraform, Grafana


Must have

  • 5+ years commercial backend experience
  • Strong Node.js + NestJS
  • Solid MySQL optimisation experience in production environments
  • Deep AWS hands-on experience
  • Comfortable using AI dev tools day-to-day (Copilot / Claude / similar)
